title: Universal Type-I Volumetric Geometry + 4D State Kernel
purpose: Normalize 2D traces, 3D embedded structures and state/history-aware 4D assemblies into reusable geometry/topology kernels beneath the 411×60 owner matrix. Use canonical closed forms only in their valid regimes; otherwise require field/matrix/network solves and explicit boundary/interface state.
